tests.name: test_ascii_below_0x60_control_chars
tests.intent: Probe serialization of control characters below 0x60 (such as \x00 through \x1F) to verify their escape sequences generated via the new table lookup.

tests.name: test_ascii_quotes_and_backslashes
tests.intent: Probe serialization of quote and backslash characters which trigger the bulk scanner stop and table-based direct write.

tests.name: test_ensure_ascii_del_character
tests.intent: Probe serialization of DEL (0x7F) with ensure_ascii enabled to verify that code points >= 0x60 route correctly through the updated decoder path.

tests.name: test_mixed_printable_ascii_below_0x60
tests.intent: Probe serialization of printable ASCII characters in the range 0x20 to 0x5F to check their direct table copy without modifications.

tests.name: test_buffer_flush_mid_string_escapes
tests.intent: Probe serialization with a long sequence of control characters to ensure write buffer flushes correctly when filled by table escapes.

tests.name: test_non_ascii_unicode_ensure_ascii
tests.intent: Probe serialization of non-ASCII multibyte UTF-8 sequences under ensure_ascii to verify proper \u-escaping via the non-accept/decoder paths.

tests.name: test_invalid_utf8_keep_handler
tests.intent: Probe serialization of strings containing malformed UTF-8 byte sequences with keep error handler to test boundary interactions with bulk scanners.

tests.name: test_windows_paths_string_serialization
tests.intent: Probe serialization of typical Windows path strings heavily populated with backslashes and low-index ASCII characters.

tests.name: test_log_lines_with_mixed_escapes
tests.intent: Probe serialization of log lines containing carriage returns, tabs, newlines, and quotes.

tests.name: test_empty_string_serialization
tests.intent: Probe serialization of an empty string to verify edge case handling in the bulk scanner and write buffer setup.

tests.name: test_string_with_only_backslashes
tests.intent: Probe serialization of a string consisting entirely of backslashes to stress the direct write buffer limit and table lookups.

tests.name: test_string_with_only_quotes
tests.intent: Probe serialization of a string consisting entirely of quotation marks.

tests.name: test_high_unicode_surrogate_pairs
tests.intent: Probe serialization of high code points requiring surrogate pairs under ensure_ascii.

tests.name: test_indentation_pretty_printing
tests.intent: Probe pretty-printing dump with indentation (dump(2)) on a string containing characters below 0x60.

tests.name: test_binary_type_serialization
tests.intent: Probe binary type container serialization which exercises serialization buffers and output mechanics.

tests.name: test_string_boundary_stride_lengths
tests.intent: Probe strings of varying lengths around typical bulk scanner block strides containing control characters.

tests.name: test_serializer_error_handler_replace
tests.intent: Probe serialization with replace error handler on invalid UTF-8 sequences.

tests.name: test_control_characters_boundary_0x1F_0x20
tests.intent: Probe the exact boundary between control characters (0x1F) and space/printable characters (0x20) in table lookup.

tests.name: test_control_characters_boundary_0x5F_0x60
tests.intent: Probe the exact boundary condition around 0x5F and 0x60 where table lookup for ASCII escapes switches behavior.

tests.name: test_json_in_json_nested_strings
tests.intent: Probe serialization of deeply nested or repetitive string data containing frequent quotes and backslashes.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercise pending bytes in string_buffer before encountering a byte below 0x60 in serializer dump_escaped_impl to flush string_buffer and hit table direct write.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercise write buffer flushing when a table escape sequence below 0x60 exceeds remaining buffer capacity during serialization.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercise EnsureAscii decoding branch for code points >= 0x7F with error_handler keep.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercise ascii_escapes table initialization and every entry lookup via a comprehensive string containing all characters from 0x00 to 0x5F.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercise specific table elements for control characters like 0x00, 0x0F, and printable characters like 0x20 and 0x5F directly through custom stream insertion of serializer.

tests.name: gen_25_fixed
tests.intent: Exercise specific table elements for control characters like 0x00, 0x0F, and printable characters like 0x20 and 0x5F directly through custom stream insertion of serializer.
